turns.input: *He asks Blackthorn who they think he is and where he comes from.*
turns.draft:
Blackthorn stood in the square, her short, round frame clad in a tailored aubergine-purple suit, black bob framing a face with nearly black eyes. Two large bodyguards flanked her, their presence a silent statement. She regarded the tall, overweight man with the white hairs who had approached her.

"I have no idea who you are," she said, her voice clipped and pragmatic. "And I don't care where you come from. What I care about is why you're standing in front of me. Do you have business, or are you wasting my time?"
